messages:
Amanda: Heads up — got several alerts from notify-prod but incident-bot didn't page the oncall. Anyone else seeing missed pages?

incident-bot: delivery_failure | incident-bot -> pagerflow webhook | status=403 | body="X-Incoming-Source: blocked"

Raj: I'm seeing the same in gateway logs. A new auth filter rollout started ~14:28 that adds a header allowlist. Looks like incident-bot's webhook header isn't on the list.

Mike: that was my change in the notify-auth rollout, I added a stricter incoming-header check to block unsigned sources. Didn't think it would affect internal webhooks. Rolling it back now.

Lisa: Manual paging in progress — I've notified the oncall via SMS and phone. @Mike thanks for rollback. Please confirm when incident-bot pages resume.

Emily: Customer impact — Support received 2 escalations from Production customers about delayed alerts, and we have 3 internal SLO misses recorded in the 14:25-14:40 window. Creating SEV ticket and adding affected customer IDs.

Mike: rollback initiated.

deploy-bot: deploy | service=notify-auth | action=rollback | user=mike | id=rollback-0x17b | status=in_progress

Raj: Quick note: header key is `X-Incident-Source`. auth filter rejects anything not explicitly allowlisted. incident-bot uses `X-Incident-Source: incident-bot/1` — guess that wasn't in the list.

Amanda: Mitigation note: manual pages covered oncall during outage. After rollback incident-bot retried and pages started flowing again. Need a runbook change to avoid this.

Mike: rollback complete — :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy | service=notify-auth | action=rollback | id=rollback-0x17b | status=success | finished_by=mike

incident-bot: delivery_status | resumed | queued=0 | failed=3 (retries sent)

Lisa: Thanks. Next steps: 1) Add incident-bot header to allowlist, 2) add automated integration test that posts a synthetic webhook from incident-bot to pagerflow on deploy, 3) update runbook with manual paging checklist.

Raj: I'll open PR to add the header and add a unit/integration check. Also propose a short circuit: if webhook responses are 4xx/5xx for >2 minutes, post to #incidents and escalate to pager duty manually.

Emily: Working on customer comms: draft will include timeline, what we did, and next steps. Will post to #support-daily once ready.

Amanda: Scheduling retro for tomorrow 10:00 PT — include SRE, notify team, support, and platform security. I'll own the postmortem doc.

Mike: I'll add the integration test to CI and run it against a staging pagerflow.

Raj: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/notify-auth/pull/482 — adds `X-Incident-Source: incident-bot` to allowlist and unit tests for header validation.

Lisa: Also adding a monitoring alert: if incident-bot webhook 4xx rate > 1/minute, trigger immediate oncall ping.

Amanda: Good. For the SEV ticket: severity=low-medium due to limited customer impact and manual mitigation. Emily will handle comms.

Emily: Draft ready, pushing to #support-daily in 15.

incident-bot: annotation | INC-2026-104 | tags=[paging, webhook, rollout, manual-mitigation]

Amanda: Thanks everyone. We'll capture action items in the postmortem.

Mike: going to add a note in the deploy checklist to run the incident-bot integration test before promoting auth filter to prod.

Raj: I'll also add a short qa playbook entry for oncall to verify webhook connectivity after infra rollouts.

Lisa: Closing the thread after retro scheduling. :lock:
